caption: The drawing features a heraldic coat of arms centered within a black diamond-shaped field that is bordered by two thin gold lines. The main element is a shield with a silver and grey crosshatch pattern, bearing three gold-colored lion faces in a triangular arrangement. Above the shield there is a helmet facing left, decorated with gold and silver detailing and topped with a crown and what appears to be a gold lion’s face or mask. Flowing from the helmet and surrounding the shield are ornamental mantling and acanthus leaves in gold, green, blue, pink, and light red shades. Below the shield is a curling ribbon or banner in a reddish-brown color with partially visible gold colored text. The background outside the black diamond is off-white, and in the bottom right corner is the small text “William E. Roberts, del.” indicating the artist’s name.
title: Coat of Arms
